headline: Rikhav Securities to host investor meet on Sep 24
summary: Rikhav Securities Ltd will hold a virtual group meeting for analysts and investors on September 24, 2026. The company confirmed no UPSI will be shared during the session.

headline: Dilip Buildcon sells stake in solar project to Alpha Alternatives
summary: Dilip Buildcon has sold a stake in an ongoing solar project to Alpha Alternatives for about ₹6,829 crore. The project cost is estimated at ₹6,263 crore, with equity split at 51:49.

headline: Thyrocare to sell Nuclear Healthcare stake for ₹141.4 crore
summary: Thyrocare Technologies board approved the sale of its full stake in Nuclear Healthcare Limited to Trovera Healthcare for ₹141.4 crore, alongside property purchases in Gurugram and Hyderabad.

headline: Glenmark Pharma to host analyst meet in Mumbai
summary: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Ltd will hold an analyst and institutional investor meeting on September 29, 2026, in Mumbai for the PL Capital Emerging Titans 2026 Conference.

headline: Onward Technologies wins contract worth ₹44.4 crore
summary: Onward Technologies has secured a new contract valued at ₹44.4 crore, marking a significant order win for the engineering services company.

headline: Onward Technologies wins Rs 44.46 crore order from global equipment maker
summary: Onward Technologies secures a Rs 44.46 crore managed digital services contract for an e-commerce platform. The order adds to a backlog of Rs 99.00 crore, representing 0.70 quarters of revenue.

headline: Anlon Healthcare sets ₹17.85 preferential issue price
summary: Anlon Healthcare finalizes pricing for share swap to acquire Apiqo Organics and Bizotic Lifescience. The floor price of ₹17.85 per share matches the valuer's fair value, ensuring compliance with SEBI ICDR regulations.

headline: Transformers & Rectifiers declares 25% dividend
summary: Transformers & Rectifiers (India) Limited declared a 25% dividend at ₹0.25 per share during its 32nd AGM. The meeting, chaired by Jitendra U. Mamtora, also saw the reappointment of director Satyen J. Mamtora.

headline: Royal Sense promoter releases pledge on 10 lakh shares
summary: Rishabh Arora, promoter of Royal Sense Ltd, released the pledge on 10,00,000 shares held with Comfort Securities Ltd on September 17, 2026. The move reduces encumbered holdings to zero.

headline: Shri Vasuprada pays ₹1.04 cr NCD interest on time
summary: Shri Vasuprada Plantations Ltd confirmed timely payment of ₹1.04 crore interest on its 9% secured NCDs. The payout was made on September 21, 2026, for the issue size of ₹23 crore.

headline: Rollatainers seeks approval for ₹100 crore Satellite Forgings stake buy
summary: Rollatainers board approved addendum to AGM notice for acquiring shares of related party Satellite Forgings Private Limited for up to ₹100 crore. Shareholder approval needed.

headline: Bajaj Global appoints new independent directors at AGM
summary: Bajaj Global Limited held its 41st AGM on September 21, 2026, approving the appointment of two new independent directors and reappointing Monal Malji. The meeting also adopted audited financials for FY26.

headline: Asian Warehousing holds 14th AGM, approves key resolutions
summary: Asian Warehousing Limited held its 14th AGM on September 21, 2026. The meeting approved the adoption of audited financial statements for FY26 and the re-appointment of Bhavik Bhimjyani as Chairman & Managing Director.

headline: Shree Hari Chemicals promoters transfer shares
summary: Promoters of Shree Hari Chemicals Export Ltd transferred 56,595 equity shares amongst themselves on September 18, 2026. The transaction, valued at ₹236 per share, was executed under SAST Regulation 10(1)(a)(ii).

headline: Mantra Capital appoints Prasanta Kumar Mohanty as CS
summary: Mantra Capital Limited has appointed Prasanta Kumar Mohanty as Company Secretary cum Compliance Officer effective September 21, 2026. The Board approved the move after NRC recommendation.
